knowledge:
- key_parameters: chtag=Character string representing the chromosome (e.g., "21") to process in altize ;; slpack=Character string naming the SNPlocs package to load in altize ;; hgpack=Character string naming the BSgenome package to load in altize ;; faElFun=Function to generate the FASTA element name based on the chromosome tag in altize ;; faTargFun=Function to generate the target FASTA file name based on the chromosome tag in altize
- alternatives: matchPWM from Biostrings (parallelized via foreach/doParallel) can be used to generate custom motif-match ranges instead of using pre-computed FIMO-based TFBS.
- when_to_use: Use when investigating the regulatory impact of GWAS variants by linking them to transcription factor binding sites and phenotypes to construct bipartite VTP networks.
- pitfalls: Matching motifs to the reference genome without SNP injection (ALT-allele injection) is potentially problematic because variants can create or destroy binding sites ;; Identification of TP links is highly sensitive to the motif matching scheme and threshold used (e.g., 75% vs 85% vs FIMO) ;; Ensure chromosome tags passed to altize do not contain "ch" or "chr" prefixes, though the function attempts to clear them with a warning.

workflows.name: vtp_network_construction
workflows.intent: Intersect GWAS variants with transcription factor binding sites and filter by disease map to identify phenotype-TF links.
input: gwas_variants.GRanges (GRanges object containing user's GWAS variants)
tf_binding_sites.GRanges (GRanges object containing transcription factor binding sites)
disease_map.RData (mapping of phenotypes to broader classes)
workflows.stages: 1. Load GWAS variants and TF binding sites ;; 2. Find overlaps between GWAS variants and TF binding sites using overlapsAny ;; 3. Filter the GWAS variants by a disease map using filterGWASbyMap ;; 4. Identify specific hits using getOneHits
workflows.code:
data(pax4_85)
vp_pax4_85 = maurGWAS[ overlapsAny(maurGWAS, pax4_85) ]
length(vp_pax4_85)
data(pax4_75)
vp_pax4_75 = maurGWAS[ overlapsAny(maurGWAS, pax4_75) ]
length(vp_pax4_75)
data(cancerMap)
requireNamespace("gwascat")
load(system.file("legacy/gwrngs19.rda", package="gwascat"))
cangw = filterGWASbyMap( gwrngs19, cancerMap )
getOneHits( pax4, cangw, "fimo" )

workflows.name: motif_match_search
workflows.intent: Generate custom motif-match ranges across the genome using parallelized PWM matching.
input: motif_query.txt (character string of the transcription factor name to query in MotifDb)
reference_genome.pkg (BSgenome package for the target species)
workflows.stages: 1. Register parallel backend using registerDoParallel ;; 2. Query MotifDb for the target transcription factor ;; 3. Run parallelized matchPWM across chromosomes ;; 4. Combine results into a single GRanges object
workflows.code:
library(foreach)
library(doParallel)
registerDoParallel(cores=12)
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19)
library(MotifDb)
sn = seqnames(Hsapiens)[1:24]
pax4 = query(MotifDb, "pax4")[[1]]
ans = foreach(i=1:24) %dopar% {
 cat(i)
 subj = Hsapiens[[ sn[i] ]]
 matchPWM( pax4, subj, "75%" )
}
pax4_75 = 
 do.call(c, lapply(1:length(ans), function(x) 
  {GRanges(sn[x], as(ans[[x]], "IRanges"))}))
save(pax4_75, file="pax4_75.rda")

workflows.name: alt_allele_injection
workflows.intent: Generate an ALT-allele injected FASTA genome image for a specific chromosome to enable variant-aware motif matching.
input: chromosome_id.txt (character string of the chromosome to modify)
snps_database.pkg (SNPlocs package containing SNP locations and alleles)
reference_genome.pkg (BSgenome package containing the reference sequence)
workflows.stages: 1. Call altize with the target chromosome tag and package names to replace reference alleles with alternative alleles and write to a FASTA file
workflows.code:
altize = function(chtag = "21",
  slpack="SNPlocs.Hsapiens.dbSNP.20120608",
  hgpack ="BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19",
  faElFun = function(x) sub("%%TAG%%", x, "alt%%TAG%%chr"),
  faTargFun = function(x) 
     sub("%%TAG%%", x, "alt%%TAG%%_hg19.fa")) {
    require(slpack, character.only=TRUE)
    require(hgpack, character.only=TRUE)
    require("ShortRead", character.only=TRUE)
    chk = grep("ch|chr", chtag)
    if (length(chk)>0) {
      warning("clearing prefix ch or chr from chtag")
      chtag = gsub("ch|chr", "", chtag)
      }
    snpgettag = paste0("ch", chtag)
    ggettag = paste0("chr", chtag)
    cursnps = getSNPlocs(snpgettag, as.GRanges=TRUE)
    curgenome = unmasked(Hsapiens[[ggettag]])
    ref_allele = 
     strsplit(as.character(curgenome[start(cursnps)]),
        NULL, fixed=TRUE)[[1L]]
    all_alleles = IUPAC_CODE_MAP[cursnps$alleles_as_ambig]
    alt_alleles = mapply( function(ref,all)
      sub(ref, "", all, fixed=TRUE),
        ref_allele, all_alleles, USE.NAMES=FALSE)
    cursnps$ref_allele = ref_allele
    cursnps$alt_alleles = alt_alleles
    cursnps$one_alt = substr(cursnps$alt_alleles, 1, 1)
    altg = list(replaceLetterAt(curgenome, start(cursnps),
      cursnps$one_alt))
    names(altg) = faElFun(chtag)
    writeFasta(DNAStringSet(altg), file=faTargFun(chtag))
}
